question_text: When was the Declaration of Independence adopted?

why_it_matters.text: July 4, 1776 is the day the Continental Congress officially adopted the Declaration of Independence. It marks the moment 13 colonies stopped being British subjects and declared themselves a new nation. Every July 4 since has been celebrated as the country's birthday.

fun_fact.text: July 4, 1776 is when the Continental Congress adopted the Declaration's text — but most delegates didn't actually sign it until August 2. So Independence Day celebrates the day we voted, not the day we signed.
